Your Mac (MacBook Pro 14, DEV-0005) shows as compliant in our system. It has no open issues, and its last check-in was 2026-11-11. The Drive problem may be left over from an earlier non-compliant state that hasn't refreshed yet.

Jamf marks a Mac non-compliant if FileVault is off, macOS is more than one major version behind, or it hasn't checked in for 14 days. Non-compliant Macs lose access to Drive and the VPN. Here is what to try:
1. Check that FileVault is on in System Settings > Privacy & Security.
2. Make sure the Mac is online so it can check in with Jamf, then sign out of Drive and sign back in.
3. If it still says "not compliant," re-enroll the Mac. Remove any old Larkspur profile in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Profiles. Then go to enroll.example.test in Safari, sign in, and install the downloaded profile.

If it's still broken after that, reply with the exact message you see and I'll pass it to the IT team.
